items.html:
(to the question) The twelve diagonal boundaries
It is known that the five Hassadim, called HGT NH, are opposite the five phases of KHB ZON, and it is found that the essence of ZA is only Netzah. And from the side of its Mochin from AVI, which receive from the corresponding phase in AB of AK, in which the Sefirot were interchanged, so that the light of Hochma came into the vessel of Keter, and so forth, and the light of Netzah ascended into Tifferet — hence the essence of ZA is discerned as the Tifferet of the ten Sefirot, and its phases of Hesed and Gevura are by the power of its inclusion in the upper ones, and its NHY are by the power of the inclusion of Malchut in it. Thus the Tifferet includes all the VAK. And it is known that by the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, a left line is made in all the Sefirot, for the essence of the Sefirot is discerned as the right line, and the phase of the coarseness of Malchut included in each and every Sefira, up to the Einayim, is discerned as the left line. Accordingly, there are found to be two phases of VAK in ZA: the first of the right line, and the second of the left line, and they are called the twelve diagonal boundaries, for each phase has a boundary of its own. And they are called diagonal [Alachson], because the inclusion of the two Heys made by the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim is called a diagonal, for a line is made in them from the face to the back: since the upper point is of the phase of the face, from the Garon upward, and the lower point is of the phase of the back, from the Tabur downward, they are therefore understood as a diagonal, which runs from the face to the back. And this is the secret that the Parsa in the middle of the body, which is the root of this ascent, stands diagonally, as is known. (Page 229, Item 262).
